syntax.evidence: Script ran to completion on Python 3.14.5, no syntax errors. All 7 steps completed.

input_contract.evidence: Reads male_cleaned.csv with utf-8-sig encoding; renames Chinese column names to English; dropna on required columns (gest_week, bmi, y_conc, patient); patient cast to str. 1082 rows, 267 patients loaded correctly.

method_alignment.evidence: M1 implements approved GAMM: y_conc ~ bs(gest_week,df=4) + bs(bmi,df=3) + (1+gest_week|patient) using patsy B-spline basis + statsmodels MixedLM. M2 implements LME baseline: y_conc ~ gest_week + bmi + (1+gest_week|patient). Multiple optimizer fallback (lbfgs/powell/cg/nm). ICC computed manually. LR test for model comparison. Residual diagnostics (Shapiro, skewness, kurtosis) and partial effect plots generated.

reproducibility.evidence: SEED=42 via np.random.seed(42). patsy design_info saved and reused for prediction (avoids refit-knot errors). Environment recorded in run_summary.json. All outputs saved to files.

output_contract.evidence: run_summary.json contains: question, round, decision_id, methods (with status/metrics/diagnostics/fixed_effects/random_effects_variance), model_comparison (LR test), icc, seed, environment, inputs, outputs, degeneracy_check, fallback_trigger, warnings, errors. 9 figures, 3 tables, 1 metrics JSON saved.

issues.description: Shapiro p=0.0 for both models (n=1082 makes Shapiro overpowered), but skewness=0.12 is mild — not a practical concern
